skills.name: requirements-elicitation
skills.when_to_use: At the start of /feature, /epic, /new-project flows to produce the signed requirements artifact.

skills.name: task-decomposition
skills.when_to_use: In /epic and /new-project flows to split signed requirements into independently-verifiable, routed tasks.

skills.name: tdd-dispatch
skills.when_to_use: To run the TDD chain (test-writer red, implementer with tests locked, verifier) for one task artifact, ending in a draft PR.

skills.name: requirements-docs-maintainer
skills.when_to_use: When a change affects requirements, planning, feature status, decisions, or workflow policy and canonical docs must stay synchronized.

skills.name: finish-branch-and-pr
skills.when_to_use: When implementation is complete and the branch needs verification, docs sync, and PR preparation.

skills.name: local-dev-and-ci
skills.when_to_use: For local environment setup, CI baseline checks, and operational workflow updates.

skills.name: security-and-dependency-triage
skills.when_to_use: For GitHub security findings, dependency-bot alerts/PRs, and security remediation discipline.

skills.name: task-intake-and-scope
skills.when_to_use: At the start of implementation tasks to clarify scope and verification.

skills.name: safe-edit-and-verify
skills.when_to_use: When editing files and preparing to validate changes.

skills.name: debug-failure-loop
skills.when_to_use: When lint, tests, or runtime checks fail and root cause is not obvious.

skills.name: local-cloud-route
skills.when_to_use: When deciding whether an agent run should be local or cloud.

skills.name: dependency-quality-triage
skills.when_to_use: When handling dependency/security findings from Renovate, SonarCloud, or scanners.

skills.name: pipeline-orchestration
skills.when_to_use: When routing work across Bugbot, SDK, and Automations lanes or starting Pillar D delivery.

skills.name: sdk-remediation-routing
skills.when_to_use: When /cursor-fix or cursor-fix-attempt.yml runs gated SDK remediation.

skills.name: maintenance-dispatch
skills.when_to_use: When processing maintenance-queue.json for Pillar C weekly dispatch.

skills.name: bugbot-advisory
skills.when_to_use: When consuming Bugbot output as advisory context for SDK or IDE remediation without duplicating review.
